name: Ling Studio (Ant Group)
description: Ant Group's Ling models on a free daily quota, OpenAI-compatible.
overview: Ling Studio is Ant Group's platform for the Ling, Ring and Ming model families. After registering at ling.tbox.cn/open and binding an Alipay account, developers get an API key with a 500,000-token daily allowance on an OpenAI-compatible endpoint at api.tbox.cn/api/llm/v1, with a 128K context window and no card. The chat playground works without an account; API access is what needs the Alipay step.
free_access: Alipay binding instead of a card
notes: Registration requires binding an Alipay account, so mainland identity tools help.
